name: LTP pattern through four temporal coil pairs, 0.5 s per pair, 20 min (Tsang 2009 mood study)
summary: The LTP arm of Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2009 that was presented once every 4 s: one pulse and, 170 ms later, four quick pulses, at 1 uT, passed through four left-right pairs of coils in boxes over the temporal lobes, 0.5 s per pair, 20 min once a week for 3 weeks. The paper reports lower fatigue scores than with a sham field in 4 people per group; the same pattern repeated every 20 ms raised confusion scores.
notes: Tsang 2009: 32 people in 8 groups of four got one of 7 field configurations or a sham field, 20 min once a week for 3 weeks, with 5 min of baseline before and after (p.1-3 [365-367]). Two boxes on a headphone frame sat over the temporal regions, four solenoids each; one left and one right solenoid were connected, and each pair got the signal for 0.5 s, 2 s per cycle (p.3 [367]). The LTP pattern 'was one pulse followed 170 ms later by four quick pulses', with positive-only 1-ms points, 'presented once every 4,000 ms'; Table 1 lists a second LTP arm with a 20-ms interval (p.4 [368]). It is rebuilt from that description: 1-ms pulses at 0, 170, 180, 190 and 200 ms, then a 4-s gap. The paper gives neither the width of the pulses nor the spacing of the four quick ones; 10 ms is this project's choice (the lab elsewhere says 100 to 200 Hz). One left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. The paper gives 1 uT and does not say where it was measured (p.1 [365]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT the scalp gets about 24 uT. Scores after/before (Table 3 p.6 [370]): fatigue 0.91 for this arm, 1.09 for the 20-ms arm, 1.08 for sham; confusion 0.95, 1.15 and 0.93; depression 0.97 and 0.95 against 1.00 for sham. Four people per group, post hoc tests at p < .10 (p.6 [370]), single lab, never independently replicated. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not a treatment for low mood or depression. Not for anyone with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on headache, nausea or distress.
setting: Seated, eyes closed, in a quiet, dim room. The study had 5 min of baseline before and 5 min after the 20-min field. Fill in the same mood questionnaire (the study used the Profile of Mood States) before and after each session.
schedule: 20 min once a week for 3 weeks. To separate the pattern from expectation, compare blinded against the sham program and the random-field arm.
source: Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2009, Electromagn Biol Med 28:365 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20017627/ ; Corradini 2014, MA thesis, Laurentian University (primed-burst LTP file) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/1455e1f3-2f1d-47b5-93cd-23713d69e651 ; Delparte & Persinger 2007, Int J Neurosci 117:295 ('1 s pulse of 5 trains') https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17365115/ ; Persinger 2010, NeuroQuantology 8(4):444 (the LTP pattern: a primer then 4 pulses about 170 ms later at 100-200 Hz) http://web.archive.org/web/20150426091303id_/http://www.neuroquantology.com/index.php/journal/article/download/301/346 ; Persinger & Lavallee 2010, J Conscious Explor Res 1(7):785 (ring order and the '20+2' notation) https://jcer.com/index.php/jcj/article/view/99 ; Lehman 2016, PhD thesis, Laurentian University, pp. 56-57 (CCW standard, 1-5 uT inside each solenoid) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/e809389f-805c-4414-8177-d0bf8d7127bb ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
